sections.title: About Lawhenz Energy
sections.content: Lawhenz Energy Ltd is a renewable energy and power solutions company providing reliable, scalable and sustainable energy solutions for homes, businesses, institutions and commercial facilities. We design, supply, install and maintain solar energy systems tailored to each client's energy needs, load profile, budget, and future expansion plans.

sections.title: What We Provide
sections.description: Overview of our core energy solutions and technical services:
rows: Solar and battery systems for homes, estates, and high-energy properties.
Large-scale solar solutions for businesses, factories, offices, and institutions.
Complete Engineering, Procurement, Construction, testing, and commissioning.
Advanced storage solutions for backup power and improved energy independence.
Integration of Solar, Battery, Grid, and Generator for optimal efficiency.
Professional energy audits, system monitoring, and after-sales support.

items.insight: Delivering reliable solar and battery systems designed for high-energy residential and commercial facilities.
Integrating solar, battery, grid, and generator networks for industrial and institutional clients.
